requirements.title: This SAS is accepted by a human and each authorized Warrant pins the accepted revision.
A human authorizes and resolves each delivery Warrant; an agent cannot perform either act.
Resolution requires bounded gate evidence and verification independent of the performer.
Graph kind checks, rewrites, and lowering preserve the declared semantic identity over stated fixtures.
Effect and partiality declarations select tested runtime protocols, including explicit refusal and gap paths.
Durable resume proves recovery and cache identity under named crash and replay fixtures.
External cookbooks can run typed plans and their own TUI without adopting BLUT's widget toolkit.
Web, ingress, notification, and telemetry sidecars enforce their declared authorization and custody boundaries.
Distributed capabilities are claimed rung by rung only at the scale directly exercised.
A release candidate has reproducible package, documentation, smoke, CI, provenance, and rollback evidence before publication.
